sentences.text:
.....petitioners
 Mr. Ayan Basu
 Mr. Debaki Nandan Maiti
 Mr. Asumdipta Santra
 Mr. Sumit Routh
 Ms. Akshita Singh
 ....... for the petitioners
 1.
Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits in 2012 they had purchased the land from their brother Taskhand Naseem against valuable consideration.
In 2018 impugned criminal proceeding was initiated on behalf of Taskhand alleging the transfer was on the strength of forged documents.
It may not be out of place to note there was bank transfer of Rs.80,000/- in favour of Taskhand as part of the sale consideration.
A counter case has also been lodged by the petitioners against Taskhand Naseem.
2. In view of the aforesaid facts, I admit the petition.

3. Copy of the petition be served upon opposite party 1/State through learned Public Prosecutor,
High Court, Calcutta and opposite party no. 2 through registered speed post with acknowledgement due and affidavit-of-service be filed on the next date of hearing.
4. Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" four weeks after Puja Vacation.
CRR/3659/2024 on 5 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57360749/
1 5.

There shall be stay of operation of the proceedings in connection with G.R. Case No. 6480 of 2018 arising out of Baruipur Police Station Case No. 2034 dated 02.11.2018 under Sections 420/468 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Baruipur, South 24 Paragans for a period of six weeks after Puja Vacation or until further orders whichever is earlier.
